nodes.title: Architecture authority
nodes.purpose: Defines product invariants, subsystem direction, ownership boundaries, and the canonical repository graph.
public_contracts: One canonical owner per shared fact
limitations: Describes authority and boundaries; it does not prove physical behavior
safe_change_workflow: Update canonical architecture data
Regenerate projections
Run foundation and Atlas contracts

nodes.title: Schema contracts
nodes.purpose: Defines strict machine-readable shapes for every shared repository fact and generated contract.
limitations: Schemas validate structure and bounded values, not real hardware behavior
safe_change_workflow: Change the schema and canonical sample together
Regenerate every binding
Run schema, generated-freshness, and consumer tests

nodes.title: Assurance and release evidence
nodes.purpose: Owns explicit design coverage, bounded formal models, performance budgets, dependency and coverage inventories, public journey source coverage, quality audits, and release gates.
owns: Journey source coverage and privacy review
Dependency, coverage, quality, formal, and performance assurance
public_contracts: No test result alone makes a release
Missing evidence is reported, never assumed
limitations: Software evidence cannot replace physical qualification
safe_change_workflow: Update the narrow canonical authority
Regenerate evidence views
Run assurance, model, and release-impact checks

nodes.title: Application integration catalog
nodes.purpose: Defines application-neutral adapter identities, upstream pins, coexistence rules, and SDK-only transport boundaries.
public_contracts: Upstream names never grant write authority
limitations: Catalog inclusion describes an adapter contract, not hardware qualification
safe_change_workflow: Update the canonical integration record
Regenerate all language bindings
Run integration and affected adapter contracts

nodes.title: Composable hardware profiles
nodes.purpose: Composes receiver, surface, and child identities with evidence-bound capabilities and independent routes.
public_contracts: Exact identity plus public evidence gates writes
limitations: Only two child profiles currently carry physical qualification
safe_change_workflow: Add evidence before capability
Regenerate every profile projection
Run profile, integration, kernel, and change-selection contracts

nodes.title: Device knowledge
nodes.purpose: Records provenance-bound candidate facts, semantic capabilities, upstream records, disagreements, and explicit unknowns.
public_contracts: Imported support never promotes a route
limitations: Research candidates remain non-writable until separately qualified
safe_change_workflow: Review and cite the new fact
Refresh only the exact bounded upstream catalog
Regenerate and run knowledge plus profile contracts

nodes.title: Versioned bridge protocol
nodes.purpose: Defines bounded request, response, event, negotiation, and compatibility contracts across protocol generations.
outputs: Rust, Python, and C++ protocol bindings
limitations: Wire compatibility alone does not admit a hardware route
safe_change_workflow: Add a new version without rewriting history
Regenerate all SDKs
Run protocol, SDK, bridge, and package contracts

nodes.title: OpenRGB adapter
nodes.purpose: Runs pinned upstream Razer controllers over qualified HyperFlux Feature routes while preserving ordinary hidapi devices.
limitations: Physical OpenRGB behavior remains qualified only for the current public profiles
safe_change_workflow: Change only the Feature transport or route owner
Compile against the exact upstream pin
Run native-route, sanitizer, SDK, and package contracts

nodes.title: OpenRazer native route
nodes.purpose: Extends pinned OpenRazer with trusted feature-only HyperFlux routes while preserving ordinary USB devices and the official daemon API.
limitations: Read parity is recorded method by method for the two physically proven devices; their write parity rests on the physical acceptance summary
safe_change_workflow: Update the pinned source or declarative route contract
Regenerate the source transform and relay metadata
Run metadata, native-route, stock userspace, and package tests

nodes.title: Device qualification console
nodes.purpose: Provides a source-only browser surface for bounded qualification projections without remote data or direct browser hardware access.
limitations: No installed qualification command is exposed; the fixture server previews static source contracts only
safe_change_workflow: Change the versioned Rust projection or static browser contract once
Regenerate Rust-bound fixtures and repository views
Run console, Rust, package, and browser checks

nodes.title: Rust workspace
nodes.purpose: Coordinates the Rust dependency graph and compile-time ownership boundaries across production and simulation crates.
limitations: Workspace success does not validate kernel or application adapters
safe_change_workflow: Change the narrow crate manifest
Refresh the lock only when required
Run format, clippy, unit, and affected integration tests

nodes.title: System probe
nodes.purpose: Owns bounded local system inspection, Full-component detection, root-only receipt creation, and the explicit disconnected-driver activation boundary used by operator tools.
limitations: The crate is workspace-only; its consumers decide how probe results are presented or acted upon
safe_change_workflow: Change one bounded probe or activation contract
Keep receipt and timeout bounds explicit
Run probe, operations, public API, and package contracts

nodes.title: Device qualification runtime
nodes.purpose: Coordinates the source-only local qualification projection, lifecycle, evidence, migration, runner, server, and maintainer onboarding workflow.
public_contracts: Never installed in Core or Full
Source compatibility remains available through hfx_ops re-exports
limitations: The browser workflow is a maintainer tool and does not make a release
safe_change_workflow: Change one qualification owner
Preserve profile and generation binding
Run qualification, onboarding, Rust, public API, and package contracts

nodes.title: Core policy engine
nodes.purpose: Owns receiver generations, qualified native routes, child-local arbitration, bounded transactions, retained fallback restoration, and typed diagnostics.
limitations: The core never performs transport or filesystem I/O directly
safe_change_workflow: Update one state-machine owner
Add deterministic unit scenarios
Run core, simulator, formal-model, and bridge contracts

nodes.title: Bridge runtime
nodes.purpose: Adapts the core to protocol-v7 native routes and exchanges plus retained protocol-v6 sessions, persistence, subscriptions, snapshots, and bounded RPC dispatch.
outputs: Native route snapshots and exchange outcomes
limitations: Production process policy belongs to the daemon crate
safe_change_workflow: Change the relevant adapter module
Exercise framing and persistence failure paths
Run bridge, simulator, SDK, and daemon tests

nodes.title: Production daemon
nodes.purpose: Composes production discovery, configuration, native-route authority, service lifecycle, logging, and the retained restoration fallback around the bridge.
limitations: No remote control plane or network service is provided
safe_change_workflow: Change composition without moving domain policy
Test startup and shutdown failure modes
Run daemon, package, and lifecycle contracts

nodes.title: Rust SDK
nodes.purpose: Provides the typed Rust client contract for qualified route discovery, bounded native exchanges, and retained semantic consumers.
outputs: Typed native routes and availability events
NativeControl leases and exact Feature exchanges
public_contracts: No arbitrary USB or receiver-frame escape hatch
limitations: The Rust SDK is local-process infrastructure, not a network API
safe_change_workflow: Change the protocol catalog first when wire-visible
Preserve typed compatibility
Run SDK, protocol, bridge, and consumer tests

nodes.title: Operations CLI
nodes.purpose: Provides the installed bounded status, Doctor, support-bundle, and explicit driver-activation command surfaces while preserving historical hfx_ops source imports through re-exports.
public_contracts: Installed hyperfluxctl is limited to status, Doctor, and support
Historical hfx_ops imports continue to compile
limitations: Qualification and onboarding remain source-only workspace tools, not installed commands
safe_change_workflow: Keep each installed command on a typed local boundary
Preserve exact CLI fixtures and source re-exports
Run Rust, public API, and package contracts

nodes.title: Kernel transport adapter
nodes.purpose: Adapts the generated kernel UAPI into bounded Rust observation, routing, envelope I/O, and qualified native exchanges.
public_contracts: Uncertain native writes are never replayed
limitations: Requires the matching installed kernel module for live operation
safe_change_workflow: Change the canonical UAPI first
Regenerate bindings
Run transport, kernel, bridge, and package contracts

nodes.title: Deterministic simulator
nodes.purpose: Exercises generations, failures, persistence, restoration, and replay without hardware.
limitations: Simulation evidence is distinct from physical qualification
safe_change_workflow: Reuse production domain policy
Add deterministic fixtures and failure cases
Run simulator and formal-model contracts

nodes.title: Kernel driver contract
nodes.purpose: Defines additive generated userspace ABIs and the strict boundary around the in-kernel receiver transport.
limitations: Live loading and physical validation are outside software verification
safe_change_workflow: Add a catalog without rewriting an existing ABI
Regenerate kernel and Rust bindings
Run ABI-freeze, kernel, SDK, and package contracts

nodes.title: Linux HID kernel module
nodes.purpose: Binds the receiver, preserves generic input, records passive observations, performs qualified fixed-size native exchanges, and retains bounded migration envelopes.
public_contracts: One SET attempt per native exchange
limitations: Software compilation is not physical regression proof
safe_change_workflow: Keep policy in userspace
Add warning-fatal smoke coverage
Run kernel, profile, protocol, and package contracts

nodes.title: Linux runtime authority
nodes.purpose: Defines package version, service identities, filesystem paths, permissions, activation, and runtime defaults once.
public_contracts: Loopback snapshots are read-only by default and use explicit evidence states
limitations: Distribution-specific packaging remains a separate projection
safe_change_workflow: Update the relevant runtime authority once
Regenerate every affected service, language constant, and document
Run generation, install, and package contracts

nodes.title: Packaging and installation
nodes.purpose: Builds reproducible distribution artifacts, a canonical installed root, and signed public repository metadata from explicit manifests.
limitations: Private signing material remains outside the publishable repository and release assets
safe_change_workflow: Update canonical install or distribution data
Regenerate the staged plan
Run install, distribution, package, and release-impact contracts

nodes.title: C++ SDK
nodes.purpose: Provides typed C++ bridge access for qualified native routes, exact Feature exchanges, and generated adapter contracts.
inputs: Domain, protocol, profile, and error catalogs
outputs: Native route and Feature transport contract
public_contracts: No arbitrary USB or receiver-frame API
limitations: The C++ library does not declare a stable binary interface
safe_change_workflow: Change canonical schemas for shared types
Regenerate headers
Run warning-fatal SDK and native adapter contracts

nodes.title: Python SDK
nodes.purpose: Provides typed Python bridge access and generated contracts for scripting and Python application adapters.
inputs: Domain, protocol, profile, and error catalogs
limitations: The Arch packages do not install it and the project publishes no Python package; use it from the source tree
safe_change_workflow: Change canonical schemas for shared types
Regenerate modules
Run Python SDK, adapter, and package contracts

nodes.title: Repository tooling
nodes.purpose: Provides the single developer CLI, canonical loaders, deterministic generators, and verification orchestration.
limitations: Tooling projects canonical truth; it is not an independent product authority
safe_change_workflow: Change the narrow loader or generator owner
Add focused deterministic tests
Run generation twice and the affected verification lane

nodes.title: Contract tests
nodes.purpose: Holds language-specific, cross-language, fixture, lifecycle, repository-navigation, and change-impact tests.
public_contracts: Software tests perform no hardware writes
limitations: Tests demonstrate modeled behavior, not universal physical compatibility
safe_change_workflow: Add the smallest contract that exposes the risk
Keep fixtures sanitized and bounded
Run focused tests before the selected lane

nodes.title: GitHub governance authority
nodes.purpose: Defines repository ownership, immutable automation, public collaboration, remote synchronization, dependency policy, and the public publication state from one authority.
outputs: Protection, collaboration, security, and service-evaluation plans
public_contracts: Product releases are maintainer-operated, not published by workflows
limitations: Remote synchronization applies only reviewed public-source components and does not publish packages or write hardware
safe_change_workflow: Update the relevant governance authority
Regenerate every affected GitHub or licensing projection
Run governance, licensing, generated-freshness, and workflow checks

nodes.title: Documentation system
nodes.purpose: Organizes concise audience guidance and generated technical references for direct use inside GitHub.
public_contracts: Generated facts identify their canonical source
limitations: Repository documentation describes the published Arch release only
safe_change_workflow: Change reviewed source or canonical data
Regenerate repository views
Run navigation, link, freshness, and audience-entry contracts

nodes.title: Verification graph
nodes.purpose: Defines typed verification nodes, dependencies, lanes, capabilities, side effects, evidence, timing, and change selection.
limitations: A green software lane is neither physical evidence nor a release
safe_change_workflow: Add or update the typed node
Test dependency and changed-path selection
Run the affected lane and preserve exact evidence

nodes.title: Error catalog
nodes.purpose: Defines stable typed error identities, user-safe messages, remediation, and cross-language mappings.
outputs: Rust, Python, and C++ error bindings
limitations: The catalog cannot replace structured subsystem diagnostics
safe_change_workflow: Add the canonical error once
Regenerate every language binding
Run error, SDK, Doctor, and privacy contracts

nodes.title: Pinned development toolchains
nodes.purpose: Pins compiler, interpreter, upstream checkout, and development-container identities for reproducible local verification.
limitations: Preparing upstream checkouts may require network access outside offline verification
safe_change_workflow: Review and update one exact pin
Regenerate the environment
Run toolchain, development, and affected consumer contracts
